grid_boundaries: integer linspace in original image; left/top inclusive, right/bottom exclusive
detection_side: arithmetic mean of width and height in original pixels
exemplar_side: median of three per-box arithmetic mean sides in original pixels
objectness: raw objectness of retained B0 detections
density_resize: crop padding, bilinear float64 align_corners=False, rescale total mass
density_storage: all original-size arrays on server; hashes and cell masses in public results
fusion_objective: mean squared cell-count error + 0.001 * sum(non-intercept coefficients squared)
localization_edge: euclidean distance <= 0.5 * mean exemplar arithmetic side
